title: The Trial of the Veteran
text: A hooded thing stands in the road with a sword across its knees, so still that frost has formed on its shoulders. It wants the one among you who has seen the most, and it will not take anyone else. It has waited a long time.

options.label: The most travelled faces it alone, since no one else will do.

outcomes.text: Steel rings on steel for a long time. Then the hooded thing steps aside and bows.
It is better than anyone they have fought. It lets them live, and they will carry the lesson.
